Metadata.title: Arnaldo Espinoza · Full Stack Web Developer
Metadata.description: Portfolio of Arnaldo Espinoza (ajedev): full stack web development with Next.js, Nest.js and PostgreSQL, web design, SEO, and network and infrastructure services.

Hero.web-developer: Full stack web developer · Network administrator
Hero.brief-description: I build websites and web applications with Next.js, Nest.js and PostgreSQL, backed by more than 20 years of experience in technical support, networking and servers.

About.information-title: From networks and servers to full stack development
About.information-description: I started out in technical support and network and server administration, configuring Linux servers, routers and switches. Today I focus on full stack web development: React and Next.js with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS on the frontend; Node.js, Nest.js, MySQL and PostgreSQL on the backend. I'm passionate about technology, enjoy teamwork and I'm always learning.

Services.web-development-description: Custom websites and applications, frontend and backend: admin dashboards, API integrations, databases and deployment on your own server or in the cloud.
Services.web-design-description: Responsive, accessible and fast websites, designed around your brand and built to turn visitors into clients.
Services.seo-description: Search engine optimization: structure, metadata, performance and content to improve your organic ranking on Google.
Services.networks-description: Design, installation and configuration of LAN/Wi-Fi networks, routers, switches and Linux servers for homes and businesses, backed by experience as Head of Networks and CCNA instructor.

Works.last-projects-description: Here are some of the most recent projects I've built for clients and on my own.

items.food: Food e-commerce platform with public store, cart, checkout, admin dashboard and real-time kitchen workflow.
items.globalsi-app: Application for Globalsi (Chile) to track support and installation jobs carried out in the field.
items.vencol: Corporate website for Vencol Technology, a technical support, connectivity and security company in Colombia.
items.portfolio: Portfolio template for web developers, multilingual and with dark mode.
items.aje-pass: App to generate and manage secure passwords for your different services.
items.vit: Admin-managed website for Venezolana de Industrias Tecnológicas to publish drivers for its devices.
items.cook-recipes: Recipe finder powered by the Edamam API.
items.movinet: Commercial website for an IT services company, built on the Odoo CRM.

meta.title: Network and infrastructure services in Venezuela
meta.description: Installation and configuration of LAN and Wi-Fi networks, routers, switches, Linux servers and security for homes and businesses. On-site service in Punto Fijo, Falcón state and across Venezuela. Former Head of Networks and Cisco CCNA instructor.

hero.title: Stable, secure networks for your home or business
hero.subtitle: I design, install and configure your wired and wireless network, your devices and your servers, so everything works and is easy to manage.

diagram.title: Network diagram: internet, router, switch and devices

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: From a small office to a company's infrastructure: I take care of the network end to end.

cabling.title: Structured cabling
cabling.description: Installation and testing of network drops, rack and patch panel organization, and labeling so the network is easy to maintain.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi & coverage
wifi.description: Coverage surveys, access point placement and separate guest networks, so every space gets a stable signal.

routing.title: Routers, switches & VLANs
routing.description: Configuration of routers and managed switches, VLAN segmentation, load balancing across internet providers and quality of service.

servers.title: Linux servers
servers.description: Installation and administration of servers for files, email, websites, databases and private cloud.

security.title: Security & backups
security.description: Firewalls, VPN for remote work, access control and backup policies to protect your information.

support.title: Support & maintenance
support.description: Troubleshooting, monitoring and preventive maintenance so your network keeps running.

services.more: Need something that isn't on the list? I do much more in networking and infrastructure.

homes.title: Homes
homes.description: Wi-Fi that reaches the whole house, a securely configured router, and cameras and devices connected without dropouts.

business.title: Businesses & shops
business.description: Office and point-of-sale networks, servers, secure remote access and support so your team works without interruptions.

diagnosis.title: Assessment

proposal.title: Proposal
proposal.description: I present the solution, recommended equipment and a quote.

install.title: Installation
install.description: I install, configure and test everything, and leave the network documented.

support.title: Support
support.description: I stay with you after delivery with maintenance and support.

vit.title: Hands-on infrastructure experience
vit.description: As Head of Networks at Venezolana de Industrias Tecnológicas I maintained switches, routers and servers, plus private cloud, corporate email, databases and web hosting.

ccna.title: Cisco CCNA background
ccna.description: I was a Cisco CCNA instructor, teaching networking fundamentals, routing, switched and wireless networks and WAN technologies.

dev.title: Networks and software in one place
dev.description: As a full stack web developer, I can also build the website, intranet or application that runs on your network.
